name: 奇丽叶
evolution: 奇丽草 → 奇丽叶 Lv.16 → 奇丽花 Lv.32 → 奇丽果
evolutionEn: Qilicao → Qiliye Lv.16 → Qilihua Lv.32 → Qiliguo
description: 头顶的花苞十分巨大，花苞成长速度已经超过身体，头部上方是视野盲区，由身体下面五个足状的突起维持平衡。
descriptionEn: The bud on its head is very large, having grown faster than its body. The area above its head is a blind spot; balance is maintained by the five foot-like protrusions under its body.

skills.name: 晒太阳
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels all buffs on the opponent.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; counters an attack.

skills.name: 棘突
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; when countering an attack: the user gains Defense +70%.

skills.name: 顶端优势
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 孢子

skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.description: 为场下每个精灵回复3能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores 3 energy to each spirit off the field.

skills.name: 仙人掌刺击

skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 花炮
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击自己获得魔攻+60%。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit grants the user Magic Attack +60%.

skills.name: 盛开
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+30，应对防御：改为威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains all skills power +30; when countering a defense: instead power +60.

skills.name: 芳香诱引
skills.description: 自己获得连击数+2，应对防御：额外造成打断，且敌方下回合获得眩晕。
skills.descriptionEn: The user gains combo count +2; when countering a defense: additionally causes an interruption, and the opponent gains stun next turn.
